criteria.statement: Loom canonical projection exposes signer-first functions that accept a Signet-compatible Sign(ctx, *nostr.Event) signer.
criteria.verification: Compile-time use in internal/adapters/loom/projection.go and unit test TestProjectCanonicalJobStateWithSignerPublishesStateAndAudit.

criteria.statement: State and audit events are signed through the supplied signer before publish.
criteria.verification: Unit test asserts two signer calls, signed event IDs/signatures, and two published events.

criteria.statement: Missing or failing signers fail explicitly and do not silently fall back to raw-key signing.
criteria.verification: Unit tests cover nil signer and propagated signer errors.

criteria.statement: Raw-key compatibility remains isolated behind an explicit adapter for development/migration callers.
criteria.verification: Legacy ProjectCanonical* functions delegate through HexKeyCanonicalSigner; validated runtime config rejects raw projection keys and allow_raw_key_dev so app projection signing uses Signet only.

criteria.statement: When Loom canonical projection is enabled in production/default full mode, configuration requires Signet/NIP-46 bunker signing.
criteria.verification: TestValidateLoomCanonicalProjectionRawKeyGate covers Signet-required behavior and rejects raw-key projection config in validated runtime configuration.

criteria.statement: App startup injects the configured canonical signer into Loom client projection methods.
criteria.verification: newLoomCanonicalProjectionSigner constructs Signet signer for configured projection and rejects enabled projection without Signet; TestClientProjectCanonicalJobStateUsesConfiguredSigner proves the Loom client uses its injected signer.
